what_works: Paul's asks now read: massive deep craters that get little sun with proper shadows; mountains you go around; high plateaus with ramps; crevices; boulders with scale.
Morning and dusk light give drama without hiding the features; night is dark but readable on lit rims.

fixes.fix: Crater floor by day: raise the horizon-shadow ambient so a shadowed floor keeps 12-18% of its lit brightness with the cold blue-grey tint (now about 2%, r20_floor_crop.png). A player must see rocks, deposits and building ghosts on the floor without lamps.

Crevice walls are tall sheets of stretched triangles with jagged spikes (r20_crevice_crop.png, crevice577, crevice160). Build crevices as their own wall mesh along SIM's polyline (two lofted walls with rock noise and a floor), not from the 4 m heightfield.
Texture tiling: the pale gravel patches repeat as a regular hex-blotch pattern across the plain. Break it with a second, larger noise scale (100-300 m) and random rotation per tile.

Dashed orange deposit rings are drawn on every crater floor and slope even with no overlay open (crater675_floor, overview, start). Show them only with the resource overlay or when a surveyor has found them.
Boulders (in progress): real meshes with rounded, eroded forms, lit tops and a dust skirt; 3-4 giants per field; replace the faceted scaled rocks.
Camera: the overview only reaches about 200 m with the zoom command in my build (my overview shots are at 200 m, RENDER's at 1,300 m). Confirm the player can reach the 1,300 m view in normal play.
